text: dsh-client-ui-quote（DSH Web 插件）：让用户把 AI 回复中的选中文本作为引用附到下一条消息。它将浮动引用工具栏接入对话输入 dock，在助手回复文本上选中内容后显示引用按钮，并通过可移除的引用条展示待发送内容。主要功能包括选区校验、引用预览、按需将引用序列化为 Markdown 引文并随消息发送、旧版输入接口的草稿插入回退，以及中英文界面文案。适合需要针对回复片段追问或补充上下文的 Web 用户。使用需要 DSH Web；不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-client-ui-quote (DSH web plugin) lets users quote selected AI reply text in a follow-up. A floating toolbar and removable banner display the quote; it is sent as Markdown, with a draft insertion fallback for older interfaces. It supports Chinese and English and needs no extra keys or services.

DSH 网页聊天能不能引用我选中的回复内容？

我想在发送前看到引用内容，并能随时移除。
I want to quote part of an AI reply in my next message.
Can I select a reply excerpt and attach it to a follow-up in the web chat?
选中助手回复并引用：在对话中选择非空的助手回复文本，选区上方出现引用按钮；点击后将引用附到下一条消息。
查看并移除待发送引用：支持引用附件时，输入区上方显示引用文本条，点击移除按钮可清除引用。
兼容旧版输入接口：检测不到引用附件接口时，点击引用会把格式化的引用块追加到草稿末尾。
生成 Markdown 引用块：将所选文本逐行加上引用标记，并添加本地化的归属提示供发送使用。
引用 AI 的回答时，我希望不必手动复制粘贴。

A selection-quoting plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: select text inside an AI reply and attach it to your next message as a quote banner.

dsh-client-ui-quote README · Features：- **Selection toolbar** — one 引用 (Quote) button appears above the selection after a 50ms debounce, so it never flashes mid-drag. It hides on Escape, scroll-away, or when the selection collapses.
- **Quote banner** — a removable strip above the composer with a quote glyph, the quoted text, and a × button. The quote is consumed by the next send: the banner clears when the message goes out. Escape while the composer is focused clears it too.
- **Clean draft** — the quote is a pending-send attachment, not text in your input. Focus returns to the composer so typing follows.
- **Localized** — toolbar labels and the quote attribution follow the UI language (中文 / English).
- **Fallback for older harnesses** — on versions without the input-machine quote attachment, the button inserts the quote block at the end of the draft instead.

dsh-client-ui-quote README · Prerequisites：- DeepSeek Harness with the web GUI (`dsh web`)
- Full banner behavior needs `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` with the input-machine quote attachment (`InputActions.setQuote`). Older versions fall back to inserting the quote into the draft.

dsh-client-ui-quote README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/skyhancloud/dsh-client-ui-quote
```

Then restart `dsh web` and refresh the browser.

dsh-client-ui-quote README · Usage：1. Select any text inside an AI reply.
2. Click **引用** (Quote) above the selection — the quote appears as a banner above the composer.
3. Type your message and send — the quote is prepended to the outgoing message:

```
> 引用 AI 回复：
> <selected lines>

<your message>

4. Click × on the banner when you no longer need the quote.

```
